observations.text: Feedback, 3 Nov 09:27-11:54 UTC: 52 near-identical reports from 1 agent in one corner. The watcher output kept updating, so the job was alive. Temp files from earlier turns were also missing on 3 wakes. New.
Feedback, 3 Nov 12:10 to 4 Nov 08:45 UTC: 28 reports from 2 agents. Several show the process really exited at turn cleanup, not only a misread PID; #3408 changes the check, not process lifetime.

fixes.text: Check background job output before restarting after a wake (#3408), merged 4 Nov, not yet released

title: Agents think their background job died between wakes and restart it
whatHappens: A long watcher an agent starts in a turn is gone at the next wake, with no exit result, so the agent restarts it or loses the watch.
